storyline.latest_title: GLM-5.3 Scores 60 on Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, Matching Kimi K3 - Unite.AI

prior_narrative.tldr: Apple formally connected its China-market Apple Intelligence to Alibaba's Qwen model on Mac in early August, though a step-by-step setup guide briefly disappeared and reappeared with details relocated. The same Qwen lineage's newest 27B build was independently benchmarked days later.
prior_narrative.whats_new: Simon Willison's Aug 17 benchmark run puts Qwen 3.8 27B at 52 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, one point behind GLM-5.2 and DeepSeek V4 Pro -- a separate data point from the Mac integration, published a week after the guide confusion.
prior_narrative.why_it_matters: Qwen now spans both a first-party OS integration inside China and a competitively benchmarked open-weight release outside it; a platform engineer evaluating China-market deployments should track the Apple integration and the open-weight release as two separate paths, not one.

beats.headline: Apple formally connects Apple Intelligence on Mac to Alibaba's Qwen for eligible China users
Apple's step-by-step Mac setup guide is deleted, then reappears with details moved
Separately, the underlying Qwen 3.8 27B model scores 52 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index

open_questions: Was the deleted Mac setup guide a temporary glitch or a sign Apple paused or narrowed the integration's rollout?
Does the 27B build now benchmarked at Artificial Analysis Index 52 match what Apple Intelligence runs on Mac, or is that a separate deployment?
prior_narrative.take_for_builders: If evaluating Qwen for a China-market or on-device integration, confirm separately whether Apple's Mac integration uses the same 27B build now benchmarked at AA Index 52, and watch for official word on why the setup guide was pulled.

day_captions.8bcf84806a650602: Global Times reports Apple Intelligence formally integrates Qwen on macOS for eligible China users.
day_captions.e62587f54aeaba86: A same-day Reuters pickup confirms eligible China users can connect Qwen to Apple Intelligence on Mac.
day_captions.04d97d93fa897165: Gadget Hacks reports the step-by-step Mac setup guide was deleted, then explains where the details moved.
day_captions.4fdeab7a66fc6733: A week later, Willison independently benchmarks the underlying Qwen 3.8 27B model at 52 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index -- unrelated to the Mac integration itself.
